messages:
julianna (support): FYI customer 'AcmePayments' just escalated — their client is hitting JSON parse errors after updating to strict response_format.
julianna (support): They say API returns 200 but body starts with an HTML error page. Their parser throws a hard exception, lots of retries => billing spike. Need triage, please.
oscar (eng): Can you paste a minimal repro (curl) and any request_id/route? If strict mode is enabled we should be rejecting non-JSON at the gateway, not returning HTML 200.
julianna (support): Repro below (redacted keys). Note headers: response_format: "json", strict: "true". Observed response headers included Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and body starts with "<!DOCTYPE html>".
julianna (support): ```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-demo","input":"{\"prompt\":\"small test\"}","response_format":"json","strict":true}'
``` 
julianna (support): Response (client saw):
julianna (support): ```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
Content-Length: 534

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><title>500 Internal Error</title></head>
<body>...</body>
</html>
``` 
julianna (support): Request_id from our logs: r-20260317-ACME-req-7f9b2c. Route: /v1/generate (hosted). Customer said this started after a model rollout yesterday.
kai (eng-infra): Thanks. Two quick possibilities: 1) upstream model process crashed and our fallback health page got proxied back, or 2) streaming/early-chunk header negotiation allowed a text/html chunk before we validated final content-type. I want the gateway logs for that request_id.
oscar (eng): If strict=true we should validate Content-Type on first response and if mismatch return 422 + structured error, not pass HTML through. Looks like a bug in the early-response path. @kai can you grep router logs for r-20260317-ACME-req-7f9b2c and paste the first 10 response headers?
kai (eng-infra): Grabbed logs, pasted below (sanitized). First chunk header shows text/html, upstream_code=200, upstream_body_length=534. Also see model process exit 137 shortly after.
kai (eng-infra): ```
[router] req=r-20260317-ACME-req-7f9b2c upstream_status=200 upstream_ct="text/html; charset=utf-8" first_chunk="<!DOCTYPE html>" model_exit=137
[gateway] route=/v1/generate mode=strict response_format=json decision=proxy_first_chunk
``` 
julianna (support): Customer notes they tried disabling strict and the calls succeeded (returned JSON) — so blocking allowed retries to fall back to non-strict route and then returned JSON from a different model replica.
oscar (eng): That suggests our proxy path mistakenly forwards first-chunk HTML when strict is set, instead of rejecting. We'll need a patch: validate first bytes OR Content-Type before streaming to client in strict mode. Quick mitigation: instruct customer to set strict=false while we patch, or pin to previous model.
julianna (support): Customer is on a paid contract; they saw ~1.2M tokens billed due to retries. They've asked for billing credit. Please mark as P1 for eng.
kai (eng-infra): I'll open a hotfix PR to enforce content-type/body-shape check for strict mode before any body bytes are proxied. Also adding a streaming guard: if first_chunk does not look like JSON (no leading '{' or '[') and Content-Type != application/json -> return 422 with structured error.
oscar (eng): Good. Also add a regression test simulating upstream crash returning HTML and assert we return 422. Assigning to eng-oncall and runtime team.
deploy-bot: Deployment started for fix/strict-json-guard -> runtime-gateway (canary: 5%).
julianna (support): Thanks. I'll propose a billing credit to AcmePayments and keep them updated. Will follow up once canary is green.
oscar (eng): Follow-ups: (1) confirm whether our model-rollout logic might send health/error pages from older replicas; (2) audit other routes that honor response_format strictness. I'll create GH issues.
julianna (support): Saved notes and customer informed. Closing loop once deploy finishes. :thumbsup:
